export_metadata.source: NightCityBot production database (read-only replica) + local audit/snapshot files
export_metadata.description: Complete historical export of rent runs, cyberware runs, balance history, payments, attendance and characters for NCRP.
coverage_notes: rent_runs: when each monthly rent collection ran (run timestamp + who initiated). Earliest 2025-07-01. NOTE: rent_runs has no per-user breakdown — per-user rent detail lives in 'rent_audit_logs' (text) and, from 2026-05 onward, in balance_history.

cyberware_weekly_runs: per-week cyberware/med charge runs, each with checkup_ids, paid_ids, unpaid_ids arrays — this is the authoritative 'who paid cyberware on which week' record. Earliest 2025-06-30.
balance_history: per-user cash/bank deltas with a reason string (rent, cyberware, actor pay, etc.). Earliest entry 2026-05-01 only — this audit table was added then, so it does NOT cover 2025.
payment_labels: idempotency markers showing which user got which charge label (e.g. auto_collect_rent) and when. Earliest 2026-04-01.

rent_audit_logs: raw text logs of full monthly rent runs with per-user line-by-line detail. Only 4 months are retained on disk (July 2025, March/April/May 2026); other months' logs were on the deployment's ephemeral filesystem and are not recoverable here.
balance_snapshots.by_user: early per-user balance snapshots (cash/bank/change) captured around rent runs in June/July 2025 — the deepest balance history available for the 2025 period.
All economy data is keyed by Discord user_id, not character. Use the 'characters' table to map user_id -> character(s).
